card.name: Digits and separators inside numbers
card.fires_on: Responds to a digit, hyphen, period or space right before or inside a number, such as a dose, age range, phone number or date. It also fires on 'more' in 'no more than'.

modes.label: Inside numeric strings
modes.description: A digit or separator at the start or middle of a number, dose, age range or phone number.

modes.label: Space or word before a quantity
modes.description: A gap or the word 'more' just before a dose amount or limit.
modes.example: Isotretinoin capsules must only be dispensed in no<< more>> than a 30-day supply.

card.plain: It fires while the text is partway through writing a number, like a dose, age range or phone number.
